title: Neat-o, fun, beautiful. However, the coffee isn't as good as other methods.
text:
Neat-o, fun, beautiful. However, the coffee isn't as good as other methods.. I love the ritual, but I'm underwhelmed by the coffee it produces. For a 1-cup ritual I prefer french press and pourover. Even real espresso in a cheap home machine is better IMHO - more crema and flavor.

I originally found a Bialetti at a thrift store and didn't know what it was. I could see that it was for coffee so I brought it home and tried it. I liked the device itself quite a bit and did some research. I thought I had a one-cup version but it must be a three-cup version. I ordered this one thinking it would be six times the size of the one I found, but it's only 2x. It makes enough "espresso" (more like Americano IMHO) to fill one American coffee mug 3/4 full.

I'm just starting home roasting, and one of my goals is to roast something that really shines in the Bialetti. As it stands it is really most valuable as a conversation piece.

If you are looking for a fun method for brewing one cup of delicious coffee, I would first try pour over and french press. Those are hard to screw up. The Bialetti is neat-o and great for entertaining, but it's not really in the hunt for best cup of coffee IMHO.
